Subject: Thank you!
Dear Payton, Kevin, Chris, Mike,
Thank you for taking the time to meet with us yesterday to talk about USAID's work on countering
mis/disinformation and on the upcoming Summit for Democracy.
We look forward to following up with you and your colleagues and are happy to bring in to future
discussions our relevant colleagues working on health issues, any particular region and/or country,
or event (i.e. election or crisis environment).
I'm also attaching USAID's draft concept of potential areas of cooperation with Facebook, which
might help us better synergize our support to local civil society groups.
Best,
Josh
